## Preview

`@netlify /blog/REPLACE-WITH-SLUG/`

## Publishing checklist

- [ ] Title is final
- [ ] Path is the intended `/blog/<slug>/`
- [ ] Excerpt is suitable for listings and RSS
- [ ] Tags are correct
- [ ] Images render and have useful alt text
- [ ] External links work
- [ ] Publication date is updated
- [ ] Mobile rendering reviewed
- [ ] Netlify Deploy Preview reviewed at the preview entry path

Merge to `main` publishes the post.
